item.title: Virginia Madden, 97
item.description: Virginia T. “Ginni” Madden (nee Cagney), 97, a lifelong Oak Parker, died on Jan. 19, 2025. She attended Ascension Catholic School, Trinity High School and Rosary College (Dominican University). She taught elementary school prior to her marriage to Frank, and raised a large family in Oak Park, her most cherished role in life. item.title: Oak Park purchases electric semi-truck, hybrid police cars
item.description: Oak Park has purchased several new vehicles in line with the village’s ambition to reduce its fleet’s environmental impact. Oak Park’s village board approved deals this week to purchase a new electric semi-truck for the public works department and six hybrid police interceptor SUVs for the police department.
